dialogues.speaker: Lumidouce Harbor Noticeboard
dialogues.text: Welcome to Lumidouce Harbor. This is the Harbor Services Noticeboard. Please leave any queries or comments you have here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Beautifully-Written Note
dialogues.text: "Bertin's House of Curiosities purchases all types of antiques and exotic crafts. If interested, please contact us."

dialogues.speaker: Beautifully-Written Note
dialogues.text: "Looking for valuable collectibles of various sorts. Offering pleasing prices that are sure not to disappoint."

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Cassigneul's Reply
dialogues.text: "Many thanks for choosing to post your notice in this harbor, Ms. Mequignon."

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Cassigneul's Reply
dialogues.text: "However, when purchasing collectibles, do be selective and choose those you deal with very carefully. Otherwise, you may find yourself in unnecessary disputes."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Be careful dealing with the local forces and keep your eyes open. The frost on this line will not melt easily."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Are you troubled by frost accumulation? Allow us to sincerely recommend our newest area cleaning meka! It has excellent anti-frost properties and takes merely three seconds to solve all problems!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Speaking of which, the tea trade has been booming, yet there are fewer tea clippers coming from Liyue. Is someone deliberately driving up prices?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "I returned from Yilong Wharf last month, where I found bulk tea to be significantly more expensive than previously. I can't imagine there is much profit in the trade recently. Perhaps spices would be better..."

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Cassigneul's Reply
dialogues.text: "Tea prices continue to fluctuate within a reasonable range. Please refer to official sources for market updates and do not believe, act on, or spread unconfirmed rumors."

dialogues.speaker: Lumidouce Harbor Noticeboard
dialogues.text: "The Maison Cardinalice is intensifying preparations... Lumidouce Harbor Aquabus Plan... resume construction... aiming for year-end..."

dialogues.speaker: Lumidouce Harbor Noticeboard
dialogues.text: "...As for... full understanding... All engineers, please remain calm and actively... trust..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Do you yearn for a life-changing adventure? Do you dream of a journey to cleanse your very soul?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If you're finding your quotidian life tedious, come to Yilong Wharf and enjoy our stunning waterfalls and heavenly scenery..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Er, I'm not sure if I'm misunderstanding this. Are they... inviting Fontainians to look at waterfalls?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I've waited five months here! Five months! (blotted out) Choiseul sent me here to (blotted out)!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Ms. Cassigneul, in the name of the Iudex, I beg you! Please send another letter to the Maison Cardinalice. They once promised an 'imminent start to work'!"

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Cassigneul's Reply
dialogues.text: "Thank you for your message. I have already... done all I can to escalate this matter. Please be patient."

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Cassigneul's Reply
dialogues.text: "And please do not worry about your salaries. If necessary, I will pay them personally. I ask you to... keep your faith in the future of Lumidouce Harbor."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "You know, if there's no work for engineers here, maybe we should try our luck at Yilong Wharf? I seem to recall they once imported a cargo of clockwork meka..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Ha. You think you're the only one to think of that? Miss Hautemontagne has been there for the last three months!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "(Blotted out), is there no law and order anymore!? We've just been robbed by bandits while walking along the road!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "We will not let this stand! Those lawless brigands! How dare they think they can rob us!? We are the ones who rob!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "We wish to report those thieves! The ringleader was young, had red hair, and called himself Rouge or something!"

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Cassigneul's Reply
dialogues.text: "Many thanks for the information, and for exposing yourselves as Treasure Hoarders."

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Cassigneul's Reply
dialogues.text: "As for the robbery you suffered, the authorities are actively investigating. We hope to reach a conclusion by the time you have all returned from the Fortress of Meropide."
